correctness.rationale: Anchoring one of four iid uniform circle points, the four successive angular gaps normalized by 2pi have uniform Dirichlet(1,1,1,1), with density 3/(4pi^3) in three gaps. Transforming to nu=(a+c)/2, v=(a-c)/2, w=(b-d)/2 has Jacobian 2 and domain |v|<nu<pi-|w|. Half-angle chord addition gives Delta=4[A sin(nu/2)-B cos(nu/2)]=4H sin((nu-nu0)/2), nu0=2atan(B/A), H=sqrt(cos²(v/2)+cos²(w/2)). Feasibility of the unique nu0 and derivative bounds 2<=partial_nu Delta<=2sqrt2 prove sharp global transverse stability. Clipping |nu-nu0|<2asin(t/(4H)) yields exact threshold probability, while H>=1 permits dominated convergence to C_P=3/(2pi^3)*integral_D 1/H. Reparametrize z=Delta/t and apply the positive density Jacobian and Scheffe to obtain the marked total-variation limit. Independently integrated the diamond with adaptive quadrature: I=16.919982579064538 and C_P=.8185431011367532, matching the claimed constant; analytic proof covers all small t, not Monte Carlo.
